item.title: Lawsuit filing: Point72's quant unit Cubist claims its fired lead research analyst used Claude and Codex to steal source code before leaving for a competitor (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Lawsuit filing: Point72's quant unit Cubist claims its fired lead research analyst used Claude and Codex to steal source code before leaving for a competitor  —  Point72 Asset Management's quantitative trading unit accused a former research analyst of using Anthropic PBC's Claude and OpenAI's Codex …

item.title: SpaceX announces Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery that it says can operate for over four hours without an external power source, reportedly for $999 (Andrew Liszewski/The Verge)
item.description:
Andrew Liszewski / The Verge:
SpaceX announces Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery that it says can operate for over four hours without an external power source, reportedly for $999  —  The all-in-one satellite dish can now operate for over four hours without an external power source.﻿
